Public holidays in Bulgaria 2026 and 2027

List of public holidays and days off in Bulgaria under the Labour Code, with the day of the week. When a holiday (except Easter) falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the next working day is a day off. The Council of Ministers may also declare additional days off.
